modmenu.descriptionTranslation.eternal_r: Explore the world and collect the Eternal Relics scattered across it — each one grants you a unique power.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.desc:
While carried.
Max health +12%, plus +2% per
extra copy.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.desc:
While carried.
Blocks any hit of 20 or less.
Heavier hits become 5~10 golden
hearts instead.
Shatters for 2 minutes after use.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.d:
Right-click to install in the
left eye.
Night vision in the dark.
Cost: 1 heart of max health.
Right-click to install in the
right eye.
Reveals nearby living things.
Cost: 1 heart of max health.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left_d:
Drained; it cannot be installed.
Combine it with a Bottle
o' Enchanting to restore it.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_right_:
Drained; it cannot be installed.
Combine it with a Bottle
o' Enchanting to restore it.
While carried, or fitted
to armour.
Armour +0.5.
One share per piece worn, up to +2.
item.eternal_relic.courage_emblem.desc:
While carried.
2 absorption hearts per minute.
Up to 4 hearts.
item.eternal_relic.enchanted_rabbit_foot:
While carried.
After being hit: Speed II for
5 seconds.
If already speedy, +2 levels instead.
2 minute cooldown.
item.eternal_relic.beeswax_pendant.desc:
While carried.
Bee stings no longer poison you.
The damage still lands.
Other sources of poison remain.
item.eternal_relic.dreadful_wolf_fang_pe:
While carried.
Untamed wolves within ten blocks
are cowed and sit down;
they recover once you leave.
Bones tame a wolf at 5/6
instead of 1/3.
item.eternal_relic.traveler_pendant.desc:
While carried.
Your mount moves 15% faster.
No effect on foot, by boat
or by minecart.
item.eternal_relic.scholar_monocle.desc:
While carried.
+1 extra experience each time
you gain some.
While carried.
Tools and weapons have a 5% chance
to take no durability damage.
Armour is unaffected.
item.eternal_relic.hunter_badge.desc:
While carried.
5% chance of an extra drop
from kills you make yourself.
item.eternal_relic.round_cake.desc:
Eating it returns you to your
spawn point (the world spawn if
you never slept in a bed),
and grants fast healing
for 10 seconds.
item.eternal_relic.thorns_oath.desc:
While carried.
Reflects 20% of the damage you
actually take back at the attacker,
up to 20 points per hit.
Nothing is reflected when absorption
soaks the whole hit.
Poison, lava and falls are ignored.
item.eternal_relic.silent_boots.desc:
While carried, and only while
sneaking.
Sneaking no longer emits vibrations
when mining, placing, opening,
taking damage or eating.
Mobs detect you at half the distance.
item.eternal_relic.scavenger_magnet.desc:
While carried.
Drops within three blocks come
to you.
With the runestone inside a
scavenger's pocket, what you pick
up goes into that pocket first.
Freshly dropped items are not pulled.
item.eternal_relic.scavenger_pocket.desc:
Right-click in your main hand:
a 54-slot portable inventory.
Its contents travel with it - drop,
store it or hand it over.
Put a runestone in and pickups
go there first.
A pocket cannot hold another pocket.
item.eternal_relic.wind_cloak.desc:
Fits chestplates only.
Movement speed +15%.
Jump once more while airborne;
this resets when you land.
Hits on the back deal 1 less
(never below 0).
item.eternal_relic.eternal_emblem.desc:
Fits armour, weapons and tools.
The item cannot be destroyed by
explosions, fire, lava, cactus or
the void, and never despawns.
It counts as having Mending.
Removing the emblem ends this.
item.eternal_relic.stream_emblem.desc:
Fits helmets and boots.
Helmet: Respiration III.
Boots: Depth Strider III.
Removing the emblem ends this.
item.eternal_relic.sun_emblem.desc:
While carried, or fitted to gear.
By day: Regeneration I and
Strength I.
If you already have one of them,
it goes up 1 level instead.
item.eternal_relic.moon_emblem.desc:
While carried, or fitted to gear.
By night: Regeneration I and
Speed I.
If you already have one of them,
it goes up 1 level instead.
item.eternal_relic.hardened_iron_plate.d:
Fits armour only.
Armour +1.
One share per piece worn, up to +4.
item.eternal_relic.leather_lining.desc:
Fits armour only.
Armour toughness +0.5.
One share per piece worn, up to +2.
item.eternal_relic.scute_lining.desc:
Fits armour only.
Armour toughness +1.5, armour +0.25.
One share per piece worn,
up to +6 toughness and +1 armour.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_lining.d:
Fits armour only.
Armour toughness +1, armour +0.5.
One share per piece worn,
up to +4 toughness and +2 armour.

item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_l:
Fits chestplates only.
Swing speed -4% (both pieces -8%).
Hits on the left shoulder
deal 2.5 less (never below 0).
20% of projectiles are deflected.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_r:
Fits chestplates only.
Swing speed -4% (both pieces -8%).
Hits on the right shoulder
deal 2.5 less (never below 0).
20% of projectiles are deflected.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_p:
Fits chestplates only.
Swing speed -4%.
Hits on either shoulder
deal 2.5 less (never below 0).
20% of projectiles are deflected.
item.eternal_relic.copper_shoulder_guard:
Fits chestplates only.
Swing speed -4% (both pieces -8%).
Hits on the left shoulder
deal 1.5 less (never below 0).
15% of projectiles are deflected.

Swing speed -4% (both pieces -8%).
Hits on the right shoulder

Swing speed -4%.
Hits on either shoulder

15% of projectiles are deflected.
item.eternal_relic.mithril_chestplate_pl:
Fits chestplates only.
Armour toughness +1.
Hits on the chest deal 3 less
(never below 0).
30% of projectiles are deflected.
Magic damage -1.
Covers the chest only, not the back.
item.eternal_relic.copper_chestplate_pla:
Fits chestplates only.
Movement speed -3%.
Hits on the chest deal 1.5 less
(never below 0).
15% of projectiles are deflected.
Covers the chest only, not the back.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_cloak.desc:
While carried:
in the dark (light below 7)
you move 10% faster.
Fitted to a chestplate:
armour toughness +0.5, and
hits on the back deal 1 less.
(No day or night in the Nether/End.)
message.eternal_relic.ward_gilded: %s turns into golden hearts to share the blow for you.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.lore: It remembers how that tree swayed in the wind, and leaves that vigour with you.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.lore:
A fine ornament,
the work of a
wonder-maker. It
gathers stray EVE
into amethyst to
take your blows.
Keep it close.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.l: Where no one else is watching, it lights the world for you.
It does not watch what you watch. It watches everything behind you.
It took a blade for someone once, and was left lying where it fell.
item.eternal_relic.courage_emblem.lore: The hymn of humanity is the hymn of courage. With this emblem, we salute the brave who keep marching on.
item.eternal_relic.enchanted_rabbit_foot: Some past master enchanted this rabbit's foot with strange arts. At any rate, it is rather good for running away.
item.eternal_relic.beeswax_pendant.lore: Probably some beekeeper's old working charm. Still, it does look rather nice.
item.eternal_relic.dreadful_wolf_fang_pe: This fang came from a wolf king. An ordinary wolf that catches its scent ought to bow to you readily enough.
item.eternal_relic.traveler_pendant.lore: Traveler, walk on. The past is but a memory, and yesterday cannot return. May the road be kind to you.
item.eternal_relic.scholar_monocle.lore: Little by little, grain by grain, a tower is raised.
A nameless trinket left behind by a nameless someone.
item.eternal_relic.hunter_badge.lore: Only hunters who had proven their skill were once awarded this badge. It clearly accompanied its owner through many adventures, great and small.
item.eternal_relic.round_cake.lore: May every year's Mid-Autumn moon find us together, people and moon alike.
item.eternal_relic.silent_boots.lore:
The soles are two alchemically
treated slime blocks. If you want
to do something without being
noticed, wear these.
item.eternal_relic.scavenger_magnet.lore: Long used and once broken, it has lost the strength it had when whole. It can still draw in whatever lies close.
item.eternal_relic.scavenger_pocket.lore: I am Lishen. I feared you would run out of room, so I made this pocket. If one pocket is not enough, go pick up a few more.
item.eternal_relic.wind_cloak.lore: This cloak brims with the blessing of the wind, so when you run, of course the wind pushes you from behind.
item.eternal_relic.eternal_emblem.lore: Eternity is the fairest dream of all.
item.eternal_relic.stream_emblem.lore: Wear it, and become a fish in the water.
item.eternal_relic.sun_emblem.lore: The sun pours out its blazing light without pause and nourishes all things. Praise the sun!
item.eternal_relic.moon_emblem.lore: The moon stands quietly in the sky, guiding those who lose their way in the dark.
item.eternal_relic.hardened_iron_plate.l: No telling what was done to this iron to make it so hard, but sewn onto armour it would set a body at ease.
item.eternal_relic.leather_lining.lore: A finished leather lining, and perhaps just the thing to save its wearer's life in a tight spot.
item.eternal_relic.scute_lining.lore: So the trouble of gathering those precious scutes was not wasted — they plainly make him all the better at soaking up blows.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_lining.l: These green shells are tough and springy at once; they ought to turn aside some of the heavier blows.
item.eternal_relic.aota_branch.flavor:
The Eternal Radiance Tree
shelters every living thing
beneath its light.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring.flavor:
A small metal ring, polished
and flawless, with a sliver of
amethyst turning slowly at its
centre.
item.eternal_relic.echo_ring_drained.fla:
A small metal ring, polished
and flawless, its centre
utterly empty.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left.f:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"01" engraved on its back.
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"02" engraved on its back.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_left_d:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"01" engraved on its back.
Lightless and dull, as if its
energy were spent.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_eye_right_:
This finely wrought eye sits
heavy in your hand, with
"02" engraved on its back.
Lightless and dull, as if its
energy were spent.
item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.flavor:
A cold, hard frame of black
iron binds the pitiful soul
that flickers inside.
A copper plate with curled
edges, verdigris settled deep
in the chisel marks.
item.eternal_relic.courage_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem of some
thickness, often affixed to
armour as a symbol of
courage.
item.eternal_relic.enchanted_rabbit_foot:
A rabbit's foot with sleek,
glossy fur, shimmering with
an uncanny sheen.
item.eternal_relic.beeswax_pendant.flavo:
A small, glistening lump of
beeswax, with a tiny hole
near the top and a thin
leather cord threaded
through it.
item.eternal_relic.dreadful_wolf_fang_pe:
A great fang, giving off
the faint smell of blood.
item.eternal_relic.traveler_pendant.flav:
A small brass plate, chipped
at one corner and polished
bright, engraved with a
blessing for travelers.
item.eternal_relic.scholar_monocle.flavo:
A fine monocle with a golden
rim, still carrying what feels
like a sage's blessing.
A plain, smooth, wide ring
with no markings of any kind.
Whoever wore it is long
forgotten.
item.eternal_relic.hunter_badge.flavor:
A weather-beaten badge,
worn and scuffed all over.
item.eternal_relic.round_cake.flavor:
A cake the size of a pumpkin
pie, with what looks like a
moon drawn on top.
item.eternal_relic.thorns_oath.flavor:
A darkly beautiful rose. Lean in
and there is a faint fragrance.
item.eternal_relic.silent_boots.flavor:
A pair of soft boots on thick
soles; stepping down feels like
stepping on something you
should not.
item.eternal_relic.scavenger_magnet.flav:
An irregular slab of stone,
carved with a prayer of
attraction.
item.eternal_relic.scavenger_pocket.flav:
An odd cloth bag whose inside
is larger than its outside. ?
item.eternal_relic.wind_cloak.flavor:
A pale green cloak, washed almost
white, its hem stiff from the wind.
item.eternal_relic.eternal_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem carved with
a pattern that stands for
eternity.
item.eternal_relic.stream_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem of some
thickness, carved with a
pattern that stands for
the rivers.
item.eternal_relic.sun_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem, faintly warm
to the touch, carved with
a pattern that stands for
the sun.
item.eternal_relic.moon_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem, faintly cool
to the touch, carved with
a pattern that stands for
the moon.
item.eternal_relic.bloom_emblem.desc:
While carried, or fitted to a
chestplate (via the Relic Station).
After a melee hit, gain one random
level-1 effect for 10 seconds.
Any effect you already have is
left untouched.
15 second cooldown.
item.eternal_relic.bloom_emblem.lore: Children born of the first daylight, flowers of the vivid fields, made for joy and gladness - nature lends you its love.
item.eternal_relic.bloom_emblem.flavor:
A wax emblem carrying a faint
scent of flowers, carved with
a pattern of blossoms.
item.eternal_relic.hardened_iron_plate.f:
A plate of hard, cold iron,
yet somehow lighter than
an ordinary one.
item.eternal_relic.leather_lining.flavor:
A thick, soft grey-white
leather, springy and
pleasant to the touch.
item.eternal_relic.scute_lining.flavor:
A thick hide sewn all over
with neat rows of soft
scutes.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_lining.f:
A thick hide with great
shells of turtle sewn
onto it.
item.eternal_relic.leather_shoulder_guar: The simplest shoulder protection there is, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
The simplest shoulder protection there is, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
The simplest shoulder protection there is, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.scute_shoulder_guard_: Hardened leather with scutes sewn over it, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather with scutes sewn over it, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather with scutes sewn over it, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_shoulder: Hardened leather carrying great plates of turtle shell, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather carrying great plates of turtle shell, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather carrying great plates of turtle shell, enough to blunt a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_l: Hardened leather carrying heavy plates of iron. Its weight slows the arm that wears it, yet it still blunts a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_r: Hardened leather carrying heavy plates of iron. Its weight slows the arm that wears it, yet it still blunts a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_p: Hardened leather carrying heavy plates of iron. Its weight slows the arm that wears it, yet it still blunts a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.copper_shoulder_guard: Hardened leather carrying plates of copper. Its weight slows the arm that wears it, yet it still blunts a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather carrying plates of copper. Its weight slows the arm that wears it, yet it still blunts a few blows in a messy fight.
Hardened leather carrying plates of copper. Its weight slows the arm that wears it, yet it still blunts a few blows in a messy fight.
item.eternal_relic.mithril_chestplate_pl: A hard yet feather-light material. Worn over the chest, it ought to turn aside some of the arrows flying your way.
item.eternal_relic.copper_chestplate_pla: The plainest, most ordinary chestplate plate there is. A good pick for a beginner.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_cloak.lore: Some herbal treatment went into this cloak - it keeps you clear-headed through the night. Perhaps that is what the faint bitterness is.
item.eternal_relic.leather_shoulder_guar:
A treated leather plate,
shaped to the curve of
a left shoulder.

A treated leather plate,
shaped to the curve of
a right shoulder.

Two treated leather plates
joined as one, guarding
a shoulder on each side.
item.eternal_relic.scute_shoulder_guard_:
A leather plate closely sewn
with rows of scutes,
shaped to a left shoulder.

A leather plate closely sewn
with rows of scutes,
shaped to a right shoulder.

Two leather plates closely
sewn with rows of scutes,
guarding a shoulder on
each side.
item.eternal_relic.turtle_shell_shoulder:
A leather plate carrying
great plates of turtle
shell, shaped to a
left shoulder.

A leather plate carrying
great plates of turtle
shell, shaped to a
right shoulder.

Two leather plates carrying
great plates of turtle shell,
guarding a shoulder on
each side.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_l:
A leather plate sewn with two
great slabs of iron, shaped
to a left shoulder.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_r:
A leather plate sewn with two
great slabs of iron, shaped
to a right shoulder.
item.eternal_relic.iron_shoulder_guard_p:
Two iron-plated leather
plates joined as one,
guarding a shoulder on
each side.
item.eternal_relic.copper_shoulder_guard:
A leather plate sewn with two
great slabs of copper, shaped
to a left shoulder.

A leather plate sewn with two
great slabs of copper, shaped
to a right shoulder.

Two copper-plated leather
plates joined as one,
guarding a shoulder on
each side.
item.eternal_relic.mithril_chestplate_pl:
A round plate of some unknown,
mysterious metal, and very
light for its size.
item.eternal_relic.copper_chestplate_pla:
A round plate of copper,
heavy for its size.
item.eternal_relic.nightwatch_cloak.flav:
A black cloak of some thickness.
Wearing it leaves a faint,
bitter smell.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_debris.l: A broken shard whose name has long been forgotten.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_rough.lo: Not yet shaped, but the form is already there.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_lumber.l: The first piece a craftsman would call good stock.
What remains after everything else has been burned away.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_treasure: Rare enough that men have drawn steel over it.
It has watched an age come to its end.
item.eternal_relic.relic_sample_source.l: They say all things were born from this.
item.eternal_relic.soul_lantern.desc:
While carried.
Each kill stores 1 soul (max 13).
Press G to release every soul:
creatures around you take damage
and burning soulfire is left behind.
1 minute cooldown.
message.eternal_relic.soul_lantern_unava: The Soulfire Lantern cannot release right now: no soul fire gathered, or still cooling down.
message.eternal_relic.homestone_recorded: The Homestone marks this place - press again to return.
message.eternal_relic.homestone_returned: The Homestone carries you back to the marked place.
message.eternal_relic.homestone_no_exper: The Homestone's runes will not light - you need at least 1 experience level.
message.eternal_relic.homestone_other_di: That page lies in another dimension - the Homestone cannot reach it.
message.eternal_relic.ember_pendant_dull: The Ember Pendant has burned out - repair it with an Experience Bottle at a crafting table.
item.eternal_relic.shepherd_bell.desc:
Right-click in your main hand.
Sheep within 40 blocks walk
to you for 20 seconds.
30 second cooldown.
item.eternal_relic.shepherd_bell.lore: Perhaps it was never meant for herding sheep.
item.eternal_relic.shepherd_bell.flavor:
A bell of polished brass.
The worn leather strap
between its iron rings
is inscribed with a
prayer of calling.
item.eternal_relic.faded_charm.lore: Even more nameless than the thumb ring that nameless one left behind.
item.eternal_relic.faded_charm.flavor:
An old charm worn to a pale
gold, its edges rounded smooth.
item.eternal_relic.cracked_compass.desc:
Right-click in your hand.
Reports your position and facing.
item.eternal_relic.cracked_compass.flavo:
A brass compass with a long
crack across its lid.
item.eternal_relic.dried_clover.lore: Four leaves pressed into one; the luck got pressed in with them.
item.eternal_relic.dried_clover.flavor:
A dried four-leaf clover kept
between two sheets of paper.
item.eternal_relic.daikson_oxygen_orb.de:
Right-click in your hand:
no oxygen is used underwater
for 5 minutes.
Then 10 minutes before reuse.
item.eternal_relic.daikson_oxygen_orb.lo: Daikson workshop standby gear. The manual says: do not wait until you are out of breath.
item.eternal_relic.daikson_oxygen_orb.fl:
A half-transparent sphere with
a small glowing green gas
suspended inside.
item.eternal_relic.natural_rune.desc:
While carried.
On grass, dirt, sand, stone or
snow: movement speed +3%.
Floors you built do not count.
item.eternal_relic.natural_rune.lore: Clearly the work of an apprentice - the grooves run uneven throughout. One can only pray it does something.
item.eternal_relic.natural_rune.flavor:
A palm-sized stone slab, carved
with a crude prayer to nature.
item.eternal_relic.old_bow_oil.desc:
Only works on a bow or a
crossbow.
Arrows you shoot deal +0.5 damage.
item.eternal_relic.old_bow_oil.lore: Well... we did find something good. This oil is first-rate - but we arrived a hundred years too late, so it works at less than a tenth of what it once did.
item.eternal_relic.old_bow_oil.flavor:
A squat round glass jar, its
grease sealed in with a cork
and wax.
item.eternal_relic.old_sword_band.desc:
Only works on a melee weapon.
Melee damage +0.5.
item.eternal_relic.old_sword_band.lore: Time and tide have worn it down. The blessing of sharpness and strength this inscribed band once held has faded away, leaving only the last dregs.
item.eternal_relic.old_sword_band.flavor:
A roll of age-worn leather,
inscribed with prayer.
item.eternal_relic.reversal_pendant.desc:
While carried.
5.5% chance when hurt to reverse it:
you gain health instead of losing it.
It costs the same amount in
experience points; not enough
experience means it fails.
No effect at full health.
item.eternal_relic.reversal_pendant.lore: Turn the inverse upright; make the impossible possible. This is the symbol of reversal, the blessing of Revos. It must rank among the most useful of all blessed objects.
item.eternal_relic.reversal_pendant.flav:
A small copper plate worn nearly
diamond-shaped, carved with
the complete symbol of
reversal.
item.eternal_relic.ember_pendant.desc:
While carried.
Below 45% health, a hit detonates
a 5 block ring: 35 damage to
hostile mobs, setting them
ablaze, and 10s Fire Resistance.
35s cooldown; 21 uses, then dull.
An Experience Bottle repairs 1/3.
item.eternal_relic.ember_pendant.lore: This pendant is no longer made; its raw material was a dragon scale. Use it sparingly, and remember to keep it up with Experience Bottles.
item.eternal_relic.ember_pendant.flavor:
A warm orange-red pendant on a
leather cord; something inside
seems to burn, slowly.
item.eternal_relic.ember_pendant_dull.de:
Burned out; it cannot detonate.
Put it in a crafting table with
an Experience Bottle to restore
a third of its durability.
item.eternal_relic.ember_pendant_dull.lo: The hearth has gone cold. Yet while one spark is left, it will always burn again.
item.eternal_relic.ember_pendant_dull.fl:
A dim pendant; the light inside
has gone out, leaving only
a little warmth.
item.eternal_relic.pocket_watch.desc:
Right-click in your hand.
Reports the time of day, and
how long until dusk or dawn.
item.eternal_relic.pocket_watch.lore:
This watch is older
than your father's
father's father, yet
it still runs better
than any watch we
can make today. The
craft is long lost.
item.eternal_relic.pocket_watch.flavor:
A golden pocket
watch, its lid worn
smooth.
item.eternal_relic.weather_bottle.desc:
Right-click in your hand.
Reports the coming weather and
roughly how long until it turns.
item.eternal_relic.weather_bottle.lore:
An elemental thing
lives in this small
bottle. Best not to
open it. It is shut
in the glass, but it
is far from weak.
item.eternal_relic.weather_bottle.flavor:
A glass bottle sealed with
seawater, a wisp like a cloud
floating on the surface.
item.eternal_relic.echo_conch.desc:
Right-click in your hand.
Reports how many living things
are around, and the direction
and distance of the nearest
hostile one.
item.eternal_relic.echo_conch.lore:
Runes made from
ground echo shards
let this nautilus
shell feel every
stir of the living
things around it.
item.eternal_relic.echo_conch.flavor:
A palm-sized conch, its inner
wall glowing pearl-white.
item.eternal_relic.wax_sealed_journal.de:
Sneak + right-click: write down
the place you stand on.
Right-click: report its direction
and distance.
Only one place is kept - a new
entry replaces the old one.
item.eternal_relic.wax_sealed_journal.lo:
No simple journal.
Each page bears a
blessing of its
own. The open page
holds the anchoring
one; the rest stay
sealed behind wax.
item.eternal_relic.wax_sealed_journal.fl:
A leather journal,
its top and bottom
edges sealed with
something like wax.
item.eternal_relic.beast_whistle.desc:
Right-click in your hand.
Calls your pets within 30 blocks
to your side.
10 second cooldown.
item.eternal_relic.beast_whistle.lore: One blow, and it comes back.
item.eternal_relic.beast_whistle.flavor:
A small bone whistle, its mouth
piece worn shiny.
item.eternal_relic.echo_stone.desc:
Right-click in your hand.
Monsters within 20 blocks take
you as their target and come.
20 second cooldown.
item.eternal_relic.echo_stone.lore:
A craftwork, really.
I feel no energy.
It just makes sound
louder, purely by
its physical form.
item.eternal_relic.echo_stone.flavor:
A grey stone full of tiny pores;
held close, it hums faintly.
item.eternal_relic.homestone.desc:
Right-click in your hand to mark
where you stand; right-click again
to return there at once, at the
cost of 1 experience level.
The mark is used up on return.
3 minute cooldown. Does not work
across dimensions.
item.eternal_relic.homestone.lore: They say a sliver of the light you came by is locked in its core. However far you wander, one press pulls you home.
item.eternal_relic.homestone.flavor:
A palm-sized grey stone, a pale
blue mark cut into its centre,
cooler than the stone around it.
item.eternal_relic.snow_grip_studs.desc:
While carried.
Ice no longer makes you slide -
as steady as walking on stone.
item.eternal_relic.snow_grip_studs.lore:
Strap this simple
gadget over your
shoes and you will
not slip on ice.
item.eternal_relic.snow_grip_studs.flavo:
A light set of
spikes to slip
over your shoes.
